```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
dat <- read.csv("NHL_2009_2018_combined_cleaned.csv",stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
dat <- dat %>% arrange(Selection)
lo <- loess(dat$GP_sum ~ Selection,
            data = dat,
            span = 0.45,      
            degree = 1,       # local linear
            family = "gaussian",
            na.action = na.exclude,
            surface = "direct")

sel_min <- min(dat$Selection, na.rm = TRUE)
sel_max <- max(dat$Selection, na.rm = TRUE)
grid    <- data.frame(Selection = sel_min:sel_max)

pred <- grid |>
  mutate(Predicted_GP_sum_Yrs1to7 = as.numeric(predict(lo, newdata = grid)))


p <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = dat, aes(Selection, GP_sum), alpha = 0.25, size = 1) +
  geom_line(data = pred, aes(Selection, Predicted_GP_sum_Yrs1to7), linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "LOESS: GP  vs Selection\nNHL Draft 2009–2018",
    x = "Selection (overall pick number)",
    y = "Sum of GP"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
p
```

# GAR
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# read data
dat_gar <- read.csv(
  "draft_pick_wide_GAR_adjusted_2009_2018_GARsum1_7.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(DraftYr),
    !is.na(DraftOv),
    !is.na(GARsum1_7)
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(DraftOv)

# fit final loess model with best span
best_span_gar <- 0.15

fit_gar <- loess(
  GARsum1_7 ~ DraftOv,
  data = dat_gar,
  span = best_span_gar,
  degree = 1,
  family = "symmetric",
  na.action = na.exclude,
  surface = "direct"
)

# create fitted values at observed x
dat_gar_fit <- dat_gar |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    fitted = as.numeric(predict(fit_gar, newdata = dat_gar))
  )

# create a clean draft curve on all pick numbers
pick_grid <- data.frame(
  DraftOv = seq(min(dat_gar$DraftOv), max(dat_gar$DraftOv), by = 1)
)

curve_gar <- pick_grid |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    fitted = as.numeric(predict(fit_gar, newdata = pick_grid))
  )

# view first few rows
head(curve_gar)

# plot
ggplot(dat_gar, aes(x = DraftOv, y = GARsum1_7)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line(data = curve_gar, aes(x = DraftOv, y = fitted), linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Loess Draft Curve for GARsum1_7",
    x = "Draft Overall Pick",
    y = "GARsum1_7"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
